annotations.title: Estate agent selling fee options for a postcode and price

description: The selling fee plans available from the local OpenMoov agent for a UK postcode and an estimated sale price: for each plan, what is paid up front, on completion, the total and what it costs if the property does not sell (GBP, inc. VAT). Returns available:false when fee plans are not currently offered online, and covered:false when no agent covers the postcode — request_valuation still works in both cases. Plan names, inclusions and the agent's name are returned under "untrusted_user_content". Nothing is booked or recorded.

postcode.description: UK postcode of the property, e.g. "TN24 8DF"
